edges.reason: createManagedPool forwards execution to the internal _createPool helper.
createPool forwards execution to the internal _createPool helper with manager address(0).
msg.sender becomes the initial manager of the created managed pool.
msg.sender is passed as the manager argument and used as deployer key in _createPool.

initialize is externally callable and guarded only by the initializer modifier, so msg.sender can set manager, implementation and gelato deployer on an uninitialized or not-yet-initialized deployment.
msg.sender must equal manager() to change the shared pool implementation.
msg.sender must equal manager() to change the gelato deployer.
msg.sender must equal manager() to upgrade pools.

msg.sender must equal manager() to make pools immutable.
msg.sender must equal manager() to transfer ownership.
msg.sender must equal manager() to renounce ownership.
msg.sender must equal the proxy admin slot value to transfer the proxy admin.
msg.sender must equal the proxy admin slot value to upgrade the implementation.
msg.sender must equal the proxy admin slot value to upgrade and call.
Caller-supplied calldata is forwarded verbatim into the delegatecall in the fallback.
Admin-supplied upgrade data reaches the post-upgrade delegatecall.

onlyManager compares manager() (backed by _manager) with msg.sender; a zero or unset _manager changes the effective authorization.
initialize writes _manager, so whoever calls it first can seize the onlyManager role.
initialize marks the contract as initialized.
initialize toggles the _initializing guard flag.
initialize sets the shared pool implementation address.
initialize sets the gelato deployer address.
setPoolImplementation overwrites the implementation used by all proxies.
setGelatoDeployer overwrites the gelato deployer address.
transferOwnership rewrites _manager, moving all onlyManager authority.
renounceOwnership sets _manager to address(0), permanently removing manager-only capability.
_createPool reads the immutable uniswap factory to resolve the pool address.
_createPool uses poolImplementation as the proxy implementation for the new pool.
_createPool registers msg.sender in the _deployers set.
_createPool records the new pool under the deployer in _pools.
_createPool calls initialize on the freshly deployed proxy.
tokenA flows through token ordering into the uniswap pool lookup.
tokenB flows through token ordering into the uniswap pool lookup.
managerFee is forwarded to the pool initializer.
lowerTick is validated and forwarded to the pool initializer.
upperTick is validated and forwarded to the pool initializer.
uniPool is assigned from the factory lookup and checked for existence.
name is built via getTokenName and passed to the pool initializer.
The fallback routine executes the raw delegatecall to the implementation slot value.
_setImplementation performs the delegatecall to the new implementation with the supplied data.
_setImplementation performs the raw sstore writing the implementation slot.
_setProxyAdmin performs the raw sstore writing the proxy admin slot.
transferProxyAdmin delegates the admin slot write after the onlyProxyAdmin check.
upgradeTo rewrites the implementation through _setImplementation after the onlyProxyAdmin check.
upgradeToAndCall rewrites the implementation and then delegatecalls data.
upgradePools loops calling upgradeTo on each proxy.
upgradePoolsAndCall loops calling upgradeToAndCall on each proxy.
makePoolsImmutable loops calling transferProxyAdmin(address(0)) on each proxy.
The data argument is delegatecalled to the new implementation during upgrade.
Caller-supplied data for upgradeToAndCall is forwarded to the implementation delegatecall.
newAdmin is written into the proxy admin slot.
newImplementation is written into the implementation slot.
newImplementation is written into the implementation slot before the delegatecall.
isTopLevelCall determines whether the initializer state flags are reset on exit.

upgradeToAndCall performs an external delegatecall into the new implementation with caller-controlled data while proxy state is being mutated, allowing re-entrant execution into the pool before the upgrade has settled.
